name: validated-world
description: Local semantic change control for large, connected projects.

interface.longDescription: English-only supported workflows for inspecting and updating a local ValidatedWorld project through bounded MCP tools, explicit affected-context review, and atomic writes. Unicode graph text can be stored, but non-English workflows are unvalidated and unsupported.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project's semantic status and current priorities.
Propose a reviewed update to this project's knowledge graph.
Check what may become stale if this project claim changes.
